verifier.evidence: HTTP 200. Slug norflox-tz-tablet, title 'Norflox-TZ RF Tablet', Cipla Ltd, norfloxacin + tinidazole.
verifier.notes: MEDIUM: every pharmacy now brands this product 'Norflox-TZ RF' while our catalogue record is plain 'Norflox-TZ'. Accepted on composition per the ambiguity rule -- norfloxacin 400mg + tinidazole 600mg and manufacturer Cipla match exactly, and Apollo's slug is literally norflox-tz-tablet -- but the brand string is not identical, so capped at MEDIUM. Norflox TZ LB (adds Lactobacillus) was rejected as a different formulation.
